item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":3,"rationale":"The President presently authorizes noncompetitive conversion of qualifying cooperative education students' Schedule B appointments, thereby changing their eligibility for career or career-conditional appointment; agencies implement any actual conversion later.","evidence":"the appointment of a cooperative education student under Schedule B of the civil service rules may be converted noncompetitively to a career-conditional or career appointment"},{"segment_id":"2","code":1,"rationale":"The Civil Service Commission must issue implementing and coordinating regulations, but the segment leaves their substantive content to what the Commission considers necessary and dictates no specific legal outcome.","evidence":"shall prescribe such regulations as may be necessary to carry out the provisions of this order"},{"segment_id":"3","code":2,"rationale":"The segment mandates that the Commission's later regulations condition each student's continuation in the program on a satisfactory-performance finding, dictating a legally consequential eligibility condition to be imposed through agency rulemaking.","evidence":"shall require that continuation in the program be dependent upon a finding of satisfactory performance"},{"segment_id":"4","code":1,"rationale":"The President immediately revokes a prior executive order and sets this order's effective date; under the codebook, revocation of a prior order governing administration is internal executive housekeeping rather than a self-executing change to legal rights.","evidence":"Executive Order No. 11202 of March 5, 1965, iv hereby revoked."}]}
